setup: Hang from the bar, hands shoulder width
Pull your shoulders down from your ears
Ribs down, legs together, no swing
execution: Press the bar down with straight arms
Fold at the hips, legs straight
Touch your toes to the bar
Lower slowly back to a still hang
faults: Don't kick or swing to get up
Don't lean far back instead of folding
Don't drop out of the top

notes: Strict reps only here; kipping toes-to-bar is a different skill with more swing.
Let the swing settle before each rep, and step down rather than drop if your grip goes.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

guideBrief.cameraNote: Side view at hip height with the bar near the top of frame. The whole body from hands to feet must stay in frame at the top position.

keyPositions.label: Hang
keyPositions.describe: Hanging still from an overhand grip, arms straight, shoulders drawn down. Ribs down and legs together slightly in front of the body, a shallow hollow shape.

keyPositions.label: Halfway
keyPositions.describe: Straight legs raised to about horizontal; arms still straight and pressing the bar down so the torso tilts back a little.

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Hips fully folded, toes touching the bar between the hands. Arms nearly straight, back rounded, torso tilted back under the bar.

emphasise: Arms press the bar down to start the fold
Controlled lowering to a still hang
